title: Risk Policy Senior Officer (JESS)
description: Risk Policy Senior Officer (JESS) KPMG Jamaica (JESS) Kingston and St. Andrew / St. Ann / St. Catherine Not disclosed Permanent full-time Updated 20/11/2026 HR Log in or register to apply Share Share this job Facebook Twitter Report This Job Save Save As a Risk Policy Senior Officer, you will provide operational and administrative support to the Enterprise Policy team. OVERVIEW: KPMG Jamaica has a delivery center named "Jamaica Extended Support Services (JESS)" operating from Kingston, which is contracted to provide office support to its member firm KPMG United States ("the Client"). The Risk Policy team is responsible for the development, update, and communication of Risk management policy projects that are practice specific or have cross functional impact and/or may result in a change to existing policies within the Risk Management Manual or proposed new policies to be incorporated into the manual. JOB SUMMARY: As a Risk Policy Senior Officer, you will provide operational and administrative support to the Enterprise Policy team, by executing assigned activities, maintaining documentation and records, coordinating routine follow ups, and supporting the timely delivery of policy related work and projects. Success in this role requires strong organizational, time management, communication, attention to detail and problem solving skills, along with the ability to manage competing priorities, collaborate effectively with team members and internal stakeholders, and deliver accurate, high quality work within established deadlines. The Senior Officer reports primarily to the KJESS Manager while also receiving functional guidance and direction from designated Enterprise Policy team members responsible for the supported work. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: Provide administrative and operational support to Enterprise Policy team members in the coordination and delivery of policy related activities, projects, and initiatives. Collaborate with the local Senior Associate II to support project management activities, cross-training, process continuity, and coordination of team responsibilities. Accountable for Risk Management Manual publication to the ALEX website, including all formatting, styling, and coordination with the ALEX Department of Professional Practice team Conduct policy related research, reviews, and assessments to support policy development, identify potential gaps, and evaluate alignment with applicable requirements. Assess and coordinate incoming policy and publication requests by confirming requirements, priorities, dependencies, supporting documentation, and applicable timelines. Support coordination of assigned policy development, maintenance, and publication activities, including stakeholder follow-ups and deliverable tracking. Review policy submissions and related project documentation to confirm completeness, accuracy, required approvals, and readiness for submission or close-out. Maintain policy databases, trackers, and change logs, ensuring accurate and up-to-date records of policy activities, approvals, and outstanding actions. Monitor the Enterprise Policy shared mailbox, track incoming requests, route inquiries to appropriate stakeholders, and follow up on outstanding items. Communicate updates, follow up on requests, track outstanding actions, and escalate issues as needed. Prepare and maintain policy and project status reports and supporting data, ensuring information is accurate and up to date. Review assigned work for completeness, accuracy, and required supporting documentation. EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE: Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in business administration, communications, information management, publishing, risk management, compliance, or a related discipline is preferred; substantial relevant experience may demonstrate equivalent capability A minimum of two (2) years of relevant experience in document production, technical formatting, publishing operations, policy administration, compliance support, or a comparable professional-services environment is preferred Strong proficiency in Microsoft Word, including template-based formatting, paragraph and character styles, tables, tracked changes, document properties, and PDF conversion Solid verbal and written communication, problem-solving, analytical, and independent judgement skills to support an environment driven by customer service and teamwork Strong problem-solving skills, project management skills, and attention to detail Ability to work independently and collaboratively, manage multiple priorities, maintain strong documentation, and deliver high-quality work within deadlines in a changing environment Strong organizational and time management skills; ability to adhere to deadlines Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams and SharePoint ​ SPECIAL CONDITIONS: JESS uses a hybrid work model, allowing staff to work from home in Jamaica or in the office. Employees must be in the office at least five days per month, with more days possible if required by business needs. You are expected to use KPMG-approved Generative AI tools to support your daily work tasks. Expected to work in a fast-paced team environment. Will be working primarily in a paperless environment and expected to be using information systems for the entire workday to access data or perform activities. May be required to work extended hours periodically or on public holidays. Discover full details and apply here: [ Analyst ] Thank you for your interest in joining our team.
